body:
Hello!

I figured that url stays in sync even when components are not mounted, however the state of other components do not automatically take state from url and sync themselves.

If we have a dual page layout where the listing page and the filters pages are different, you cannot expect the listing pages to have refinements mounted, the only way to find the state is through url.

https://cl.ly/0S0X3h2L2a0K

Example. If I select apple brand, OS filter should only contain iOS. (My refinements unmount when another refinement is selected. ). My url did get updated and showed `brand=apple` however OS refinement did not take that into consideration.

However, i would prefer it at an option for the developer if he wants to create state from the current url and pass it when he wants to.
